+     * Reads len bytes of data at the given file position into the given byte array

+     * read, end of stream is detected, or an exception is thrown. Returns the total
+     * number of bytes read.
+     */

+            if (n < 0) {
+                break;
+            }
+            pos += n;
+            totalRead +=n;
+        }
+        return totalRead;
